run_voc_eval: run PASCAL VOC evaluation on detection results against ground truth annotations to compute AP
parse_rec_xml: parse a PASCAL VOC XML annotation file and return a list of object structs with bboxes
compute_voc_ap: compute VOC average precision from precision and recall arrays using 11-point or interpolated method
review_voc_eval_iou: review the voc_eval function IoU overlap computation logic for true positive and false positive marking
refactor_voc_eval_pickle: refactor the voc_eval function to use modern pickle instead of cPickle for caching annotations
